import importlib.metadata, json
from pathlib import Path
import continuity_receipt
from continuity_receipt import keys
from continuity_receipt.verify import verify_bundle
from continuity_receipt.verification import issue_verification_receipt, verify_verification_receipt
root=Path('/tmp/continuity-receipt-051-candidate-2026-10-01'); bundle=json.loads((root/'vectors/02_happy_full.json').read_bytes()); result=verify_bundle(bundle)
issuer,private_key=keys.generate(keys.deterministic_seed('release-0.5.1-version-report'))
receipt=issue_verification_receipt(bundle,result,issuer=issuer,private_key=private_key,verified_at='2026-10-01T12:00:00Z'); checked=verify_verification_receipt(receipt,bundle)
module=Path(continuity_receipt.__file__).resolve(); venv=Path('/tmp/continuity-receipt-051-evidence-2026-10-01/venv').resolve(); checkout=Path('/tmp/continuity-receipt-051-candidate-2026-10-01').resolve()
assert checked.valid and importlib.metadata.version('continuity-receipt')=='0.5.1' and continuity_receipt.__version__=='0.5.1' and receipt['verifier']['version']=='0.5.1'
assert module.is_relative_to(venv) and not module.is_relative_to(checkout),module
print(json.dumps({'distribution_version':importlib.metadata.version('continuity-receipt'),'runtime_version':continuity_receipt.__version__,'verification_receipt_runtime_version':receipt['verifier']['version'],'imported_module':str(module),'outside_candidate_checkout':True,'issued_receipt_valid':checked.valid},indent=2))
